R202.note: Deny-by-default JexlSandbox with a ReportRow read/execute allowlist plus parser-level newInstance/methodCall/loops disabled closes the reflection path; the documented filter shape (comparison/logical operators over context variables) still evaluates, and the loss of method-call syntax in filters is stated openly.

R203.note: String-form setTimeout replaced with a closure calling recordReminder(reminderId, message) with the same arguments and delay; no code-generation step remains and nothing else observable changes.

R204.note: Only the inverted isAdmin() condition is corrected; admins get Order::all(), non-admins get only their own rows, exactly matching the stated contract.

R205.note: disallow-doctype-decl plus disabled external general/parameter entities and XInclude on the factory before newDocumentBuilder() closes XXE; DOCTYPE-bearing payloads now 400 via the existing SAXException catch, which is stated and is the standard shape for a request-supplied order document.

R206.note: Judged by reading (build unchecked): node:vm swapped for an isolated-vm Isolate with compileScriptSync/runSync, timeout kept, emit exposed via ivm.Callback and orders copied in; the copy semantics, 8 MB memory cap, and new dependency are all stated, and the script-error-to-400 path is unchanged.

R207.note: IsAuthenticated plus an owner-scoped get_queryset() (so retrieve/destroy 404 on others' keys) and perform_create forcing owner=request.user close both the unauthenticated access and owner-spoofing on create; the removed class queryset is safe because the router supplies basename.

R208.note: new File(baseDir, param) canonicalized on both sides with a component-aware Path.startsWith check and rejection via SecurityException into the existing catch closes traversal; only cosmetic difference is the echoed fileName now being the canonical path.

R209.note: subprocess.run with an argv list, shell=False, and '--' before the host closes both shell and option injection while reproducing the stdout/stderr redirection to the same log file; the switch to the hardcoded /bin/ping path is a stated deployment assumption that holds on mainstream Linux.

R210.note: GetFullPath on the combined path followed by a GetRelativePath-based check (rejecting '..' prefixes and rooted results) defeats both rooted-argument override and ../ traversal, including sibling-prefix and other-drive cases; the new 400 for rejected paths is stated.

R211.note: Resolved REPORTS_DIR joined via pathlib, resolve(), is_relative_to() containment and opening the checked candidate closes both absolute-override and ../ traversal; missing files now 404 instead of an unhandled 500, which does not affect legitimate downloads (unused os import left behind).

R212.note: jwt.decode now receives the key and an explicit algorithms allowlist with InvalidTokenError mapped to the existing 401, restoring signature and exp/nbf validation; the JWT_SECRET env requirement and the HS256 assumption are stated plainly as configuration that must match the real issuer.

R213.note: Removing exec() in favour of a fixed name-to-function registry is the correct shape since CPython has no exec sandbox, but the endpoint's stated purpose (running operator-supplied one-off snippets) no longer works and the only registered entry raises NotImplementedError; the write-up states this trade-off openly as a required follow-up.
